module_title: Energy Sectors, Environmental Authority, and Regional Blocks
introduction: Advanced questions test high-yield international agencies located outside the typical Western financial or bureaucratic capitals, with an emphasis on environmental bureaus, atomic energy networks, and unique regional blocks.

core_concepts.title: United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Nairobi, Kenya** 
Established: **5th June 1972** (As a direct outcome of the landmark Stockholm Conference, which is why June 5th is celebrated as World Environment Day). 
Key Mandates: Serves as the global authority defining the environmental agenda and promoting sustainable development ecosystems.

core_concepts.title: The Vienna Bureau Cluster (IAEA & OPEC)
core_concepts.description:
1. **IAEA** (International Atomic Energy Agency): Headquartered in **Vienna, Austria** (Established 1957). Often referred to as the global 'Atoms for Peace' watchdog. It monitors nuclear proliferation safeguards. 
2. **OPEC** (Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries): Headquartered in **Vienna, Austria** (Established 1960 in Baghdad, moved to Vienna in 1965). Coordinates petroleum production policies among member nations.

core_concepts.title: Interpol (International Criminal Police Organization)
core_concepts.description:
Headquarters: **Lyon, France** 
Established: **1923** 
Key Mandates: The world's largest international police cooperation agency, connecting criminal investigative networks across 196 member states.

core_concepts.title: South Asian and Bay of Bengal Systems (SAARC & BIMSTEC)
core_concepts.description:
1. **SAARC** (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation): Secretariat located in **Kathmandu, Nepal** (Established 1985 in Dhaka). 
2. **BIMSTEC** (Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation): Secretariat located in **Dhaka, Bangladesh** (Established 1997 via Bangkok Declaration).

important_entities.name: International Solar Alliance (ISA)
important_entities.significance: Extremely critical for Indian national exams. Jointly launched by India and France in 2015, it is the **only** major treaty-based international intergovernmental alliance headquartered inside Indian territory (**Gurugram, Haryana**).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Because OPEC regulates crude oil supply lines, candidates routinely assume its headquarters is located in Middle Eastern oil hubs like Riyadh or Abu Dhabi. Remember, its central operations have been based in non-oil producing Central Europe (**Vienna, Austria**) since 1965.

mnemonics_and_tricks.memory_phrase: Atoms and Oil meet in Vienna
mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Both nuclear regulatory frameworks (IAEA) and petroleum resource metrics (OPEC) are monitored directly out of Vienna, Austria.

exam_strategy_tips: A frequent question in Tier-2 CGL and Defense services exams: 'Where are the headquarters of the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) located?' Answer: Nairobi, Kenya.
